script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The verse says you will find it again, not that it comes back to you or cannot reach a faraway shore.
The verse does not say the seed stays in a bag or that the person stares at the sky.
The verse does not say whether the wind-watcher goes on a trip.
Saying both are so busy checking the sky that the field gets ignored adds a reason and details the verse does not give.
Failing to reap does not establish that nothing gets to the market.
The verse does not say whether anyone is building a barn.
Papa Dorin says he is a cookie planet. He lives on the cookie planet; he is a cookie stamper.
Saying God's work is beyond understanding because He is the Maker adds a reason the verse does not state.
The comparison about which box will be 'the one' has no clear meaning or setup.
His years in the dark refer to his backstory without identifying the drawer, so a baker unfamiliar with it lacks the context.
